_note: Index of every content module this app ships. To add a book or a new translation/language: drop a new file under content/scripture/<translation_id>/<book_id>.json (see tools/import_scripture.py) and add one entry here -- no need to touch core.json, topics.json, or any other scripture file. Bump content_version whenever any module's data changes so SeedLoader re-seeds on next launch.
